value_thesis.one_line: Best fit for ExampleCloud: diagnose where revenue visibility and handoffs break, build the data/reporting layer to make the issue visible, then turn the analysis into operational change.
pillars: Trusted revenue visibility: dbt + BigQuery + BI plus cross-functional metric definition.
Funnel diagnosis to action: lifecycle/routing analysis reduced SLA breaches from 31% to 12%.
Scale through automation: replaced manual reporting and saved approximately 8 hours per week.

pain_specific.thesis: Can improve pipeline trust because the candidate has built reporting models, executive dashboards, and shared metric definitions across revenue teams.
Can diagnose handoff leakage because the candidate has already tied lifecycle/routing analysis to a measurable SLA improvement from 31% to 12%.
Can reduce recurring reporting drag because the candidate has automated both reporting production and CRM data-quality checks.

value_thesis.pay_justification: The posted range can be framed around source-backed economic levers: reclaimed analyst time, reduced handoff risk, stronger pipeline visibility, and evidence of influencing spend and qualified opportunities. The candidate should validate the scale of these problems before quantifying employer-specific value.
